                        Shared folder

                        Set up Handover

                        Is Handover already working at this base, on another computer?

                        So that every computer of the base sees the same handovers, choose the Google Drive folder where Handover is installed:

                        Guide

                        It saves on its own as you type. Close it and open it again and everything is exactly as you left it — sent or not.

                        1Every shift

                        Coming in Change the Shift at the top (or put today's Date). A new handover opens with everything from the last one — aircraft and open items — and the last one stays untouched in Previous Handovers. Change it by mistake? Undo.
                        WriteAircraft, Base info and Logistics info (below).
                        Leaving✉ Send email (see 4).

                        A night belongs to the day it starts: the night of the 14th ends on the morning of the 15th. The engineer repeats from the last shift of the same type, so in a block of shifts you only change it once. Reading an old shift from Previous Handovers? A note under the date says so, with a button back to yours.

                        2Aircraft

                        One line eachSorted by ETA. ✕ removes it (with Undo).
                        AOGInside the registration: the whole line goes red.
                        ETA / ETD0630 → 06:30. Leaves another day: 0630+1 or +2.
                        WorkPF WP… fill it in. ASSISTANCE puts the time now and moves the aircraft to the bottom.
                        CommentsPERFORMED marks it done in green. Anything else written shows in red: something to read.

                        3Base info · Logistics info

                        NEWWrite here. Then move it down:
                        Transfer to PENDINGStill to do. Stays in red and travels from shift to shift until someone finishes it.
                        Transfer to COMPLETEDDone. Green, and deletes itself after 2 days.
                        📅Optional deadline. Blinks red when it is due.
                        Logistics infoWhile it has anything in NEW or PENDING, the email also goes to logistics automatically (Cc). Completed items don't count.

                        4Sending the email

                        ✉ Send emailShows the report so you can check it, with who it goes to.
                        ✉ Send via GmailOpens Gmail with everything filled in and the report copied. Press Ctrl + V in the message and Send.
                        Sent?Previous Handovers shows ✓ OK. If you change something afterwards it goes back to ● PENDING: send it again.

                        Who it goes to, from which account and the logistics address: Settings → Email.

                        5Routine checks

                        The checks of the day appear in their shift. Tick them as you go; Check all ticks the lot. Add, change or delete them in Settings → Routine, one per line.

                        6Shared folder · backups

                        ● SYNCEvery computer of the base sees the same handovers, through the Google Drive folder.
                        ConnectWhen the app opens it may ask to Connect: press it. The browser needs that click once per session to let it write in the folder.
                        BackupsA copy every day in the backups folder (last 30 days). To go back to one: Settings → Data → Import.

                        7Updates

                        Handover updates itself. When there is a new version it installs it in the base folder and every computer gets it; an open window waits until nobody has used it for 5 minutes and then reloads. Handovers, half-written ones included, and settings are never touched. The version is in Settings → Data.

                        8Settings

                        BaseBase name and the time the morning shift starts.
                        EngineersAdd, rename, delete. Paste a whole list into the name box.
                        AircraftAirlines with their logo (Logo… to change it) and work codes.
                        EmailSend from, send to, logistics.
                        RoutineThe checks of each day and shift.
                        DataShared folder, backups, version.

                        Only one window at a time: opening it again brings the open one to the front. · © 2026 Aircraft Tech Tools. All rights reserved.

                        Handover is already open

                        There is another Handover window open on this computer. Everything is written in that one — use it and this window can be closed.

                        This window is not saving anything, so two windows cannot overwrite each other. If the other one is stuck or you closed it already, press “Use this window”.

                        Closing this window… The other one is flashing in the taskbar.
